info.description: API of an ameesh mesh, local mode: reads (L84), each the serialisation of the matching `--json` output of the CLI (`schema` names it); `/events` streams the event log (L85); and the human actions (L87), POST with a required `Idempotency-Key`. No route approves, produces or attaches a receipt.
